policy: Development only before held-out outcome inspection. Keep trials, task-matched controls, failures and incomplete arms. Never impute missing measurements. Count unsuccessful attempts in cost. No extra spending after a per-arm bound; report denominator. Labels are scoring-only. Historical November 1 results separate.
source: Supersede HF e44c0852a727d17a9c3f38022691fd7fa285ff8c; LongMemEval-S existing release
split: first 20 Supersede train episodes for dev; all 200 test; 72 answerable and 6 abstention transfer separately
measure: current and stale counts, cold logical tokens and actual billed repeated-call costs separately, embedding volume/wall time. Do not aggregate token costs with unpriced local compute.
guard: claim near-quality only if upper 95% paired quality loss and extra stale risk each <=5 percentage points, system token volume at least 20% lower; compare with latest too.
budget: Graphiti max 32 calls per session, max 30 USD; 10K reader input; extraction output 400; missing trials visible
